//: PROPOSAL — NOT APPLIED. Entries in runtime/core/slo-targets.ts SLO_TARGETS shape; status PROPOSED. Applying requires an owner/CTO decision (it would become CONFIGURED with owner provenance). AUTONOMY_AVAILABILITY is a LIVENESS signal (timer fired, tick passed startup with the repo on main) — it does not say autonomy works. Alert thresholds and freeze rules are PROPOSALS too — nothing is wired or active.

entries.definition: LIVENESS SLI — NOT a measure that autonomy works: fraction of epoch-aligned 15-min slots (odg-mission-runner.timer cadence) in which the mission-runner tick fired AND passed startup with the repo on main. A slot is good iff it holds ≥1 mission-attempt-log row and every row in it is an allowlisted post-startup status; empty slot (incl. timer drift slips) or any STARTUP_REFUSED / AUDIT_CHAIN_TAMPERED / unknown-status row ⇒ bad; extra rows never add slots; rolling 14 days

provenance.authoredBy: Claude Code (technical provider) — NOT a CTO/owner decision

entries.definition: fraction of completed runs of the required check 'build + typecheck + parity + tests' triggered by push to main whose FIRST attempt concluded success; any other completed conclusion (failure, timed_out, startup_failure, action_required, skipped, neutral, …) = bad; cancelled excluded (superseded); pull_request runs excluded (development signal, not an SLO); rolling 30 days. Evidence so far: 2026-10-25T20:24:28Z → 2026-11-22T17:43:52Z (27.89 days), 846 runs — budget figures computed over that window, not over 30 days

provenance.authoredBy: Claude Code (technical provider) — NOT a CTO/owner decision

alertAndFreezeProposals.status: PROPOSED — NOT APPLIED (no alert wired, no freeze active; owner decision)

alerts.rule: alert if ≥ 4 consecutive unavailable slots (1 h) OR ≥ 4 unavailable slots in one UTC day (burn ≥ 2× at 98%: 2 × 0.02 × 96 = 3.84)
alerts.basis: odg-slo-error-budget-view burnAlertFactor 2; drift slips (isolated single empty slots) make the daily rule fire occasionally — tune after the 14-day window

alerts.rule: alert on every bad push-to-main run (at ~30.33 runs/day one bad run already burns > 2× the daily 99% budget, so a per-day burn alert degenerates to 'any failure')

freezeRules.rule: if the rolling 14-day budget is exhausted: no change to mission-runner / Truth-Lock / scheduler code other than availability fixes, until the budget is positive again
if the rolling 30-day budget is exhausted: merges to main restricted to CI/reliability fixes until the budget is positive again
